name: Soulblight Gravelords

factionAbilities.name: Ancient Burial Sites
factionAbilities.effect: If there is a friendly CURSED SEPULCHRE on the battlefield, you can set up 2 additional CURSED SEPULCHRES on the battlefield. The first must be set up more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features. The second must be set up wholly outside enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features

factionAbilities.name: The Unquiet Dead
factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit that has not been deployed
factionAbilities.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the grave, It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units in the grave than there are on the battlefield.

factionAbilities.name: The Rising Dead
factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in the grave.
factionAbilities.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre and more than 9" from all enemy units, or wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield edge, wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.

factionAbilities.name: The Hunger
factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly VAMPIRE unit that used a FIGHT ability this turn to be the targets.
factionAbilities.effect: Heal (D3) each target. Heal (2D3) the target instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a FIGHT ability.

factionAbilities.name: Deathly Invocation
factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO to use this ability, then pick up to 3 friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS units wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the targets.

list: If the target is damaged, Heal (3) the target.
If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

factionAbilities.name: Endless Legions
factionAbilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO or wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.

If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more that 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use CHARGE abilities this turn.

abilities.name: Tide of Bones and Blades
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly DEATHRATTLE units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.

abilities.name: Horror Unending
abilities.effect: You can pick 1 additional target when using the 'Deathly Invocation' ability.

abilities.name: Aristocracy of the Night
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly VAMPIRE units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly VAMPIRE units that charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Dragged Down and Torn Apart
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly DEADWALKERS units in combat to be the targets.

list: Then, pick an enemy unit in combat to be the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

heroicTraits.name: Eternal Thrall
heroicTraits.declare: Pick another friendly non-UNIQUE SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY HERO to be the target.
effect: For the rest of the battle, while the target is on the battlefield:

list: If this unit is a Necromancer, add 1 to this unit's power level.
If this unit is a VAMPIRE, add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.
If this unit is DEATHRATTLE, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

artefactsOfPower.name: Shard of Night
artefactsOfPower.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).

abilities.name: Vile Transference
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit. If any enemy models were slain by this spell, Heal (D3) the caster.

abilities.name: Prison of Grief
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target has STRIKE-LAST until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Waste Away
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

generalsHandbook.name: The Never-Dead
effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 5+ for an attack that targets this unit, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Nagadron's Claws is 3.

abilities.name: The Adevore
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy HERO that was allocated any damage points inflicted by this unit's Akmet-har this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed.

abilities.name: Dark Mist
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-MONSTER SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for the target (positive and negative) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: The Mortarch of Blood
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly DEATHRATTLE INFANTRY or DEADWALKERS INFANTRY units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: Twilight's Allure
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

abilities.name: Sanguine Blur
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+ remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy non-HERO units and more than 3" from all enemy HEROES.

abilities.name: King of Shambling Bones
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly DEATHRATTLE unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target's melee weapons have Crit (2 hits) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Ancient Strategies

timing.reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit

abilities.effect: Pick a friendly non-HERO DEATHRATTLE INFANTRY unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Vanhel's Danse Macabre
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Undead Minions
effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit:

list: Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit within this unit's combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Knights of the King
abilities.effect: While any friendly DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY HEROES are within this unit's combat range both this unit and those friendly units have ward (5+)

abilities.name: Curse to Rise Once More
abilities.effect: You can return 1 slain model to this unit

abilities.name: Guardians of the King
abilities.effect: While any friendly DEATHRATTLE INFANTRY HEROES are within this unit's combat range both this unit and those friendly units have ward (5+)

abilities.name: Skeleton Legion
abilities.effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

abilities.name: Death's Descent
abilities.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Riders of Ruin
abilities.effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy INFANTRY units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

abilities.name: Trampled to Dust
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
